record.paper_title: From P systems to morphogenetic systems: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: Investigate self-replicating morphogenetic systems that achieve the best possible self-healing degree. Equivalently, determine how robust a self-replicating M system can be against injuries while still preserving self-healing in the formal sense defined for the model.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5 Investigate self-replicating M systems which are self-healing of a best possible degree.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider morphogenetic systems (M systems), a model of computation extending P systems in which a finite collection of geometric tiles and proteins interact in a metric space according to local rules to assemble structures. Within this model, a configuration is said to be self-replicating if its evolution produces, in finitely many steps, one or more disjoint copies of the original structure together with the original. A configuration is said to be self-healing of degree d (with respect to a fixed class of injuries, where an injury is the removal or displacement of up to d constituent objects from the current structure) if, after any admissible injury of size at most d, the system can, through its rules, restore a structure isomorphic to the one it would have produced without the injury.\n\nProblem: Construct and characterize self-replicating M systems that attain the largest possible degree of self-healing. Equivalently, determine the maximum degree d (as a function of the parameters of an M system, e.g., the number of tile types, rule complexity, and geometric configuration) for which there exists a self-replicating M system that is self-healing of degree d, and exhibit explicit examples achieving this bound.
artifact.status_search_result: No published results were located that resolve the construction of self-replicating M systems achieving an optimal degree of self-healing; the problem appears to remain open in the morphogenetic-systems literature.

status_evidence.title: From P systems to morphogenetic systems: an overview and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open problem listing investigations into self-replicating M systems that are self-healing of best possible degree.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in the morphogenetic systems framework with no known resolution.
